title: Public procurement open data: Portugal and Europe, 2026
description:
Measured public procurement data for January to July 2026, published by TRINTA (trinta.ai), a public tender intelligence company based in Lisbon.

  • Portugal: contracts, value and competition for every CPV code used (153,477 contracts reported to the Portal BASE, IMPIC); public buyers by contracted value; each buyer's share of direct awards (ajuste direto).
  • Europe: the share of lots drawing a single bid in the EU Official Journal (TED), by country and by CPV division (571,148 lots, eForms BT-759).
  • United Kingdom: the same measure on the Find a Tender Service, by CPV division.

Methodology: https://trinta.ai/barometro and https://trinta.ai/single-bid-europe
